previous_round.development_status: Hypotheses formulated after viewing the first round; not an independent holdout.

request: Continue the latest two-goal research without changing completed configurations or concealing their failures.

sources.title: Toward Maximum Diversification
sources.adaptation: Use only a trailing, diagonally shrunk covariance matrix to maximize the diversification ratio of already selected actual ETFs. This is not the paper's index universe or a performance replication.

sources.title: Time series momentum
sources.adaptation: Long-only ETF trend exposures; three fixed horizon signs are averaged without parameter search. No futures, short positions or claimed replication.

methodology.observation: Only completed NYSE month ends; unchanged next-open base execution and one-extra-session stress.
methodology.macro_selection: Rank the fixed five-asset universe by trailing 126-session adjusted return; retain positive-return assets up to two. Missing slots go to BIL. The three variants share the identical selection and vary only the allocation rule.
methodology.macro_allocation: Equal weighting, minimum covariance variance, or maximum diversification ratio. Covariance uses 252 trailing daily returns and fixed 10% shrinkage toward its diagonal; selected-basket weights are capped at 80% when at least two assets are selected.
methodology.macro_rank: Equal average percentile rank of 126-session momentum, low 63-session volatility and low average 63-session pairwise correlation; choose at most three positive-momentum assets and use equal slots. Missing slots go to BIL.
methodology.trend_sma: The QLD/GLD inverse-63-session-volatility allocation is reduced independently for each asset whose close is not above its trailing 200-session mean; freed exposure goes to BIL, not to the other risky asset.
methodology.trend_multi_horizon: The same inverse-volatility allocation is multiplied asset-by-asset by the fraction of 63/126/252-session total returns exceeding actual BIL over the identical horizon. No post-filter renormalization.
methodology.leverage: QLD carries embedded daily-reset 2x exposure. All account allocations are long-only and cash-funded with a fixed 2% idle reserve.
methodology.selection_bias: This is an adaptive second research round after exposed results. All six configurations and all old failures count; neither a new label nor another backtest creates an untouched holdout.
methodology.parameter_search: None. No result-driven changes to the eight first-round configurations, thresholds, costs or benchmark.
